title: proceedBranchFn wraps checkout-B/write/add/commit in one swallow-all try/catch,…
description:
proceedBranchFn wraps checkout-B/write/add/commit in one swallow-all try/catch, yet the resolver always returns 'implementing' regardless of git success. A failed branch/commit would leave the loop in 'implementing' with no cam/* branch. This matches the documented best-effort/never-throw contract (pollAndResolveGate has no try/catch), so it is intentional and non-blocking, but a future hardening could surface a failed branch creation instead of silently flipping phase.
